feature: ADR-0109 generated modifier scope visibility and queue-bound original-up recipes
abi: Pure Rust generated logical scope and private immutable scope accessors; no unsafe/FFI/dependency/ABI change; oracle not rerun.

windows.scope: Shared engine changed; Windows native build and earlier validations pending prior approval quota issue.

limitations: Scope participates in the current destination generated view; modifier difference event propagation into the next destination stage is not implemented.
ScopedGeneration is an internal queue identity and original-up recipe, not native run/epoch/session authority or actual owner recovery proof.
Caller retains ScopedActionPlan for independent actual scoped execution; logical generation restoration occurs before timed output delivery and poll does not replay it.
Exact logical reference/temporary owner budgets do not replace actual actor execution budgets; source subtree and complete parent-child stage actor remain unfinished.
Queue failure leaves recipe/scope/variables/modifiers/time unchanged; admitted old Arc Up survives activate; reset invalidates original queue credentials.
Snapshot transient scope restores final logical view after generation; context events, branch orchestration and retained old rule new-child admission remain future integration work.
Pure shared tests and existing no-input process harnesses only; no actual keyboard/devices/native duration/driver. UnsupportedActionTiming retained.
